scope: Compiled public drivable nonvirtual, nontunnel source streets excluding service, motorway, motorway_link and trunk_link; length greater than 4 m. Sampling is along both sides, with facade and along-street headings. Private airfield, indoor and full nearby-ring street coverage are not claimed.
altitude: Panorama metadata does not provide altitude. Source road-layer and estimated grade selection is retained per pose; overlapping elevations and off-ribbon panoramas remain flagged.
use: Google Street View is used for comparison only. No reference imagery, copyright strings or extracted scene attributes are published.

sourceIdentityValidation.note: Original source identities are recovered from the exact sampled road-centre coordinate, not a nearest panorama or nearby building. Runtime edge IDs are not stable and will be revalidated on the recorded final runtime. This is not a road-altitude measurement or rendered comparison.
